+title: Replay the child associations on session/resume with replayFrom start
+---
+## What
+v2 has no `session/load`. `session/resume` with `replayFrom: {type: "start"}` replays the history. Add the children to that replay.
+
+The Router already records the parent link (`SessionRecord.agentSpawn.parentSessionId`) and restores the tree (`SessionTreeRestoration`, `TranscriptTree.children(of:)`). In `Sources/FoundationModelsACPAgent/Agent/SessionResume.swift` and `SessionHistory.swift`:
+- Read the child records of the resumed session from the restored tree.
+- Replay `subagent_update` for each child, the full ancestor chain, parent before child, before any child event.
+- Replay child messages under the child id, best effort. Never guess a parent and never invent an id: a child with an unknown parent stays unexposed.
+- Replay must not send a permission request again.
+- Give each replayed child the NEW live id rule: a child id restored from disk keeps its recorded id (the table of the first task must accept a restored id).
+- Child capabilities from before the resume do not carry over: the replay sends `capabilities` fresh (idle children get none that they cannot honor).
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Resume of a session that had a nested run replays parent first, then child, then grandchild.
+- [ ] No child event comes before its `subagent_update`.
+- [ ] A child with an unknown parent is not sent.
+- [ ] No permission request is sent during the replay.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentTests/SubagentReplayTests.swift`: record a session with a nested run with the stub model, resume, check the order of the wire messages.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter SubagentReplayTests`. All pass.
+

+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #subagents
